text.name: info1
text.text: EmuConfig is the control room of your emulation setup:

text.name: info2
text.text: one place to tune cores, shaders, controllers and

text.name: info3
text.text: per-system options without opening a single file.

text.name: info5
text.text: Think of it as the workshop behind the arcade, where

text.name: info6
text.text: every emulator gets its settings dialed in before it

text.name: info7
text.text: meets the game. Tinker freely: nothing here is final.
